title: 도착하자마자 연락해요: 바로 이어서 일어난 일 말하기
objective: By the end, you can attach -자마자 to any action verb and use it to say that one thing happened immediately after another, without adding a past tense marker before it.
summary: This worksheet teaches the connecting ending -자마자, which shows that a second action happens right after the first one.

task.title: Use -자마자 correctly
task.line: Read each item, then write the -자마자 form, choose, decide, combine, or put the words in order.

forms.when: The stem ends in a vowel, like 타다 or 오다.
forms.means: As soon as (I) do A, B happens.
forms.exampleMeaning: I fell asleep as soon as I got on the bus.

forms.when: The stem ends in a consonant. Irregular stems do not change: 걷다 → 걷자마자, 만들다 → 만들자마자.
forms.means: As soon as (I) do A, B happens.
forms.exampleMeaning: The child went outside as soon as he finished eating.

forms.means: Right after doing A, B happened.
forms.exampleMeaning: My sister started at a company right after graduating from university.

forms.when: The two actions can have different subjects.
forms.means: The moment A happened, B happened.
forms.exampleMeaning: The movie started the moment I sat down.

forms.when: Tense and requests go only at the end of the sentence.
forms.means: Do B as soon as A happens.
forms.exampleMeaning: Please text me as soon as you get home.

watchOut: 어제 집에 도착했자마자 (X) → 도착하자마자 (O): Never put the past marker -았/었- before -자마자. Show the tense at the end: 도착하자마자 잤어요.
날씨가 춥자마자 (X) → 날씨가 추워지자마자 (O): Use -자마자 with action verbs, not adjectives. To show a change, use -아/어지다 first.
점심을 먹자마자 한 시간 후에 (X) → 점심을 먹고 한 시간 후에 (O): -자마자 means 'right away.' If there is time between the two actions, do not use it.
exercises: Write the -자마자 form of the verb in brackets: ① 문을 (열다) ____ 고양이가 들어왔어요. ② 월급을 (받다) ____ 다 써 버렸어요. ③ 이 노래를 (듣다) ____ 옛날 친구가 생각났어요.
Choose the correct form: ① 침대에 (누웠자마자 / 눕자마자) 잠이 들었어요. ② 내일 회사에 (가자마자 / 갔자마자) 회의를 할 거예요.
Can you rewrite each sentence with -자마자 without changing the meaning? Write Yes or No: ① 영화가 끝나고 바로 불이 켜졌어요. ② 점심을 먹고 두 시간 후에 커피를 마셨어요.
Combine the two sentences into one with -자마자: ① 문자를 받았어요. 바로 답장을 보냈어요. ② 공연이 끝났어요. 바로 사람들이 박수를 쳤어요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 비가 / 나가자마자 / 오기 시작했어요 / 제가 / 밖에
answers: ① 열자마자 ② 받자마자 ③ 듣자마자
① Yes (영화가 끝나자마자 불이 켜졌어요.) ② No (there are two hours in between)
① 문자를 받자마자 답장을 보냈어요. ② 공연이 끝나자마자 사람들이 박수를 쳤어요.
제가 밖에 나가자마자 비가 오기 시작했어요. (밖에 제가 나가자마자 비가 오기 시작했어요.)
